topic: Custom metrics missing after containerising an app
environment: Agent 7 running as a container (docker compose or ECS)
Python or Node app using a DogStatsD client
symptom_pattern: After moving an application into a container, its custom metrics stopped appearing. Agent metrics (system.*) still arrive and the Agent looks healthy.
root_cause: The DogStatsD client is still configured to send to localhost/127.0.0.1, which inside the app container is the app itself, not the Agent. UDP is fire-and-forget, so no error is raised.
resolution_path: Confirm agent status shows DogStatsD with zero or low Metric Packets
Check the client host/port config in the app
Point the client at the Agent service name (or the host IP / DD_AGENT_HOST) and make sure the Agent accepts non-local traffic

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share how your app initialises the statsd client?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: We just call initialize() with the defaults, so statsd_host is 127.0.0.1 I think. It worked on the VM.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you run agent status and paste the DogStatsD section?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Metric Packets: 0, Metric Parse Errors: 0. Is that bad?

customer_style.tone: polite but confused, assumes Datadog changed something
